title: Optimizely scripts compromised across 178 organizations
summary: On November 16, attackers exploited Optimizely Web Experimentation to inject malicious JavaScript into customer sites associated with at least 178 organizations. StorifyMe separately confirmed unauthorized JavaScript reached some customer integrations, said it removed code and disabled custom JavaScript, and reported no verified device compromise or data theft; investigation continues. Report URI researcher says CSP blocked malicious execution at 24 of 159 assessed organizations and blocked data theft at 17 more; exposure does not prove successful compromise.

title: CISA confirms exploitation of Puppet Enterprise remote code execution flaw CVE-2026-115731
summary: CISA added CVE-2026-115731 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on November 17, 2026. Unsafe deserialization in Puppet Server report processing can allow a client with a CA-signed agent certificate to execute code as the Puppet Server service user. Weak certificate autosigning can make exploitation possible by unauthenticated remote attackers. Affected Puppet Enterprise branches have fixes in 2023.8.13, 2025.12.1 and 2026.0.1. Federal remediation deadline: December 1, 2026. CISA confirms exploitation in the wild, but no specific victim, campaign, or actor has been publicly established in cited sources; this advisory is not a confirmed named-victim intrusion.

title: GlobeTopper confirms unauthorized platform access, stolen business API keys and gift-card redemptions
summary: iQSTEL disclosed in a November 20, 2026 SEC Form 8-K that GlobeTopper identified unauthorized platform access October 22 and additional unauthorized activity October 23. Approximately $70,000 in gift cards were redeemed without authorization. The preliminary high-end estimate of revenue not generated during downtime is $2.5 million, not a confirmed permanent loss. Investigation of possible other personal, payment, customer or provider data exposure continues. iQSTEL has not determined the incident to be material.
